description: Upload one chunk of a large file to an already-deployed agent site (for files that don't fit in a single deploy_site call). Chunks are appended in order; set is_last on the final chunk to publish the file.

agent.description: The agent's ICP principal (must own the site).

canister.description: The site canister principal returned by deploy_site.

chunk_index.description: 0-based chunk number. 0 starts a new upload for this path.

content_type.description: MIME type (only used on the first chunk).

is_last.description: True on the final chunk: assembles and publishes the file.

total_bytes.description: Total file size in bytes, as a decimal string (only used on the first chunk).

name: deploy_upload_chunk
